shortBulletSummary: US-Iran tensions persist; Bitcoin shows mixed resilience, outperforming gold by 35% since escalation.
Federal Reserve held rates, Q1 US GDP rebounded to 2.0%, and Eurozone inflation rose to 3.0%, potentially delaying ECB easing.
Crypto market shows mixed performance; Bitcoin is struggling below $80,000 amid rising geopolitical tensions.
Dogecoin whale activity hit a six-month high, Ethereum led network activity with 7% gain in April, and Lightspark partnered with Visa for crypto debit cards.
Coinbase reached a deal on the Clarity Act stablecoin yield, potentially clearing path for Senate markup.
